articles.title: Netflix secures 2030 World Cup TV rights in Spain
articles.summary: Netflix will broadcast World Cup games for the first time in 2030 as it secures the rights to show World Cup games in co-host Spain and Andorra.

articles.title: Russo, James both score twice as England beat Greece in World Cup play-off
articles.summary: Alessia Russo and Lauren James reiterated their importance to England as both scored twice in a 5-0 win against Greece in the second leg of their World Cup play-off first-round tie, winning 8-1 on agg
